claim: The bundled sample comparison reports four export differences.
where: Landing first action, demo receipt, README
sandbox: Open /demo/ from a clean browser context; assert the populated comparison reports four differences, then reset it.

claim: The demo comparison makes no network request outside the product origin.
sandbox: Record every request while opening /demo/ and rendering the seeded comparison; assert every request is same-origin.

claim: The sample comparison works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Use a new browser context, open /demo/, wait for the service worker, reload online, set the context offline, and reload with the populated receipt visible.

claim: The populated comparison exports a free CSV report.
where: How it works, Receipt mode section, README
sandbox: Open /demo/, download Export CSV, and assert the file has a CSV header, an error finding, and a MIDI event row.

claim: Demo sample data does not change real checker storage.
sandbox: Seed a real-license key, enter /demo/, reset the sample, and assert the real key is unchanged while only the demo: namespace is written.

claim: Receipt mode is a planned $19 one-time license and checkout stays unavailable until billing registration finishes.
where: Landing facts, Receipt mode section, Terms, README
sandbox: Open /demo/ and assert the unavailable state is visible and no checkout link can send a visitor to the unregistered endpoint.

claim: The site resolves a platform installer from same-origin release metadata.
sandbox: Open /demo/, wait for the detected platform button, and assert it resolves to a versioned GitHub Release asset without cross-origin browser requests.
